profile.purpose: Side-by-side comparison of two backyard pizza ovens, the Roccbox and the Ooni Koda 16, baking the same Neapolitan pizza in each and covering their design differences.
profile.thesis: The Roccbox and the Ooni Koda 16 perform comparably. Which to choose comes down to details: the Koda 16 fits a larger pizza and has a wraparound burner, while the Roccbox stays cooler outside and can also burn wood.
key_takeaways: The same same-day Neapolitan dough is baked in both ovens on gas, each in about 90 seconds to two minutes.
The Ooni Koda 16 has an L-shaped fire bar that runs across the back and down one side, which helps with larger pizzas and more even cooking.
The Roccbox has a single gas jet at the back, and its gas burner can be swapped for wood, which is more useful for roasting meats and vegetables than for pizza.
The Roccbox takes up to a 12-inch pizza; the Koda 16 takes up to a 16-inch, New York-size pizza.
The Roccbox exterior stays cooler to the touch than the Ooni's.
Both cost roughly $300 to $400 and are aimed at pizza enthusiasts.
Both heat up in about 45 minutes, and both can also roast vegetables, small birds and steaks. The Koda 16 can fit a spatchcocked chicken or a loaf of bread.
Forming the pizza on a wooden board and moving it to a metal peel knocks excess flour off the bottom.

outline.title: Comparing pizza ovens
outline.summary: Introduces the Roccbox, his earlier favorite, and the newer Ooni Koda 16, and sets up an identical bake in both.

outline.title: Baking in the Roccbox
outline.summary: Bakes a same-day Neapolitan pizza in the Roccbox in real time and shows the browning and underbelly. Also discusses putting basil on before or after baking.

outline.title: Baking in the Ooni Koda
outline.summary: Bakes the second pizza in the Koda 16. Covers its wraparound fire bar, the Roccbox's wood fuel option, and why to transfer from a wooden board to a metal peel. The pizza slightly burns at the back.

outline.title: Oven performance comparison
outline.summary: Compares the two pizzas and their underbellies, then covers price, how hot the exteriors get, the Ooni models he has owned, and how easy modern outdoor ovens are to use.

outline.title: Design differences
outline.summary: Covers maximum pizza size (12-inch vs 16-inch), the single gas jet vs the L-shaped burner, and what else each oven can cook.
